neighbours.label: saying how well something suits a use ('goes perfectly with', 'make great additions to', 'would work as', 'not out of place in')
fire: This red scarf goes perfectly with a plain gray coat.
These little jars make great gifts for teachers and neighbors.
The old barn would work well as a summer theater.
That lamp would not look out of place in a modern office.
Her soft voice fits perfectly with the slow piano line.
Dried herbs make great additions to soups and stews.
This small tent would work as a shelter for two.
The bench would look lovely in any garden.
quiet: This red scarf was found near a plain gray coat.
These little jars were sold to teachers and neighbors.
The old barn was built here as a summer stable.
That lamp was left out in the rain by the office.
Her soft voice was heard over the slow piano line.
Dried herbs were stored next to soups and stews.
This small tent was bought by a couple of friends.
The bench was moved from the garden.

short: how well something suits a use
notes: Card: ' to' x3, ' for' x3, ' great' x2, ' an' x2, ' easily' x2, ' fit' x2, ' as', ' perfectly', ' in'. Probe: ' perfectly' after 'goes' 1.072; ' great' after 'make' 0.688; ' as' after 'would work' 0.658; ' in' after 'out of place' 0.597; 'designed to' only 0.198; 'was washed with' 0.028; 'recorded last year' 0.053.
